critical_gaps.description: No HokomTokenEvidenceBundle or equivalent adapter connects Hokom P5 output to Saleh/Qiyas P6 input at runtime
Zero sentence-level gold cases exist across all repositories. P9-P12 are structurally impossible to test without >=2-word sentences.

Saleh/Qiyas P6-P12 candidate processing uses its own algebraic kernel (QiyasKernel + own gamma), not Taaqol vendor TransitionGate.decide(). No live Taaqol judgment covers P6-P12 candidate transitions.
Hokom canonical runner rejects current HEAD due to 23 unauthorized paths. Closure cannot be verified until unauthorized paths are licensed or removed.
0/150 corpus cases have P6-P8 gold annotation. Even single-word P6-P8 verification requires a new corpus.
